description: Source code implementing ELF file parsing utilities for Linux, including functions to validate ELF files, find sections and segments by name or type, and determine ELF class (32 or 64 bit).

methods.name: FindElfClassSection
methods.description: Template function to locate a section of a specific ELF class by name and type.

methods.name: FindElfClassSegment
methods.description: Template function to locate a segment of a specific ELF class by type.

methods.name: IsValidElf
methods.description: Checks if the provided memory points to a valid ELF file.

methods.name: ElfClass
methods.description: Returns the ELF class (32 or 64 bit) of the ELF file.

methods.name: FindElfSection
methods.description: Locates a section in an ELF file by name and type, returning its start and size.

methods.name: FindElfSegment
methods.description: Locates a segment in an ELF file by type, returning its start and size.
